snippet.title: DRAGON QUEST RPG The Cursed Tree and the Chosen Isle | Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
A closed beta test is coming for
DRAGON QUEST RPG The Cursed Tree and the Chosen Isle,
the latest adventure in the DRAGON QUEST series!

▼ Apply now! ▼
Application Website: https://dqrpg.dragonquest.com/en/cbt/
Apply by November 23 (Mon.), 2:59 PM, 2026 (UTC) to join the fun!
